## Selected Resources

This collection will include a small number of carefully developed resources related to quantitative methodology, research development, and academic professional growth.

The goal is not to create a comprehensive course archive. Instead, each resource should offer clear, useful, and intellectually substantial guidance connected to my scholarship, teaching, or leadership.

## Resource Philosophy

I share materials selectively and intentionally. Public resources should be:

- accurate;
- conceptually clear;
- useful beyond a single course;
- appropriately documented;
- connected to a broader methodological or professional purpose;
- maintainable over time.

Additional materials will be added as they are prepared for public use.

## Looking for Something Specific?

I consider requests for workshops, methodological guidance, research-development programming, and selected instructional materials.
